conclusion: The single archival B7 proteome confirms ERK-pathway machinery and TGF-beta1 protein but does not demonstrate ERK activation or attribute signalling to TGF-beta or SMAD4 loss. Total ERK is not conspicuously raised versus CRC references; this does not exclude phosphorylation-driven activity.

reference_comparators.interpretation: Within-common-gene-set rank shifts are descriptive cross-assay abundance comparisons, not clinical patient percentiles or tumour-normal fold changes. HPA control is one donor, not matched normal. Komor runs not independently verified biological donors. CPTAC paired ratios and Robles public iBAQ context are external-only; not patient comparisons.

key_evidence: ERK2/MAPK1 and ERK1/MAPK3 each have15 source-labelled unique sequences; independent reviewed-reference audit supports11 and13 gene-specific sequences allowing I/L ambiguity, respectively. Astral rank shifts -1.79 and+3.44points; KomorCRC -9.21 and-1.57points, respectively.
Upstream total-protein findings are mixed: MAP2K1 +18.61Astral points; MAP2K2 -20.93 (but+27.74KomorCRC); SOS1+20.71,RAF1+9.77; SHC1-7.37,GRB2-6.51.

TGFB1 has4 source-labelled unique sequences and+28.83Astral rank points. TGFBR2 has only1 source-labelled sequence; TGFBR1 is not assigned. This supports available pathway components, not active ligand, receptor activity or malignant-cell origin.

FOS has2 source-labelled sequences and+19.86Astral rank points; JUN has2 and-1.75. Immediate-early response proteins are not TGF-beta-specific, and these sparse findings cannot establish an ERK output program.
AKT1/AKT2 total-protein rank shifts +24.99/+22.21Astral points are not pAKT or proof of PI3K/AKT activity or TGF-beta dependence.

mpas10_protein_coverage.interpretation: Too sparse for an MPAS protein score. MPAS is an expression signature; total-protein subset is not its validated assay. Unassigned low-abundance transcription factors are not evidence of inactivity.
mpas10_protein_coverage.EPHA4_caveat: The one source-labelled EPHA4 sequence also matches another gene in the reviewed reference; independent gene-specific EPHA4 detection is not established.

phosphoprotein_audit.interpretation: No supplied phosphopeptide or site-localization values, pERK immunostaining, or phosphorylation-enriched dataset located. The assay cannot test ERK phosphorylation. Lack of a phosphorylation search/readout is not biological absence of phosphorylation.

limitations: One historical mixed-tissue proteome; current nodal disease and liver global protein state not measured.
B7 exact aliquot and tumourfraction unresolved; treatedbowelwall, smoothmuscle, fibroblasts and repair can contribute.
SMAD4 G359E functional impairment, biallelicloss and retention in this block/currentdisease unestablished.
No raw-spectrum re-search or phosphosite search performed; delivered precursor labels only.
ERK activity can change without changing totalERK abundance; EGFR/otherRTK/integrin inputs are alternative explanations even for real MAPK output.
